summary: Plan 06 P10 moves the public CI contract verifier behind commands/ with a legacy deprecation wrapper and moves the internal manifest verifier to engine/ without a compatibility path.
rationale: The CI contract is a stable public read-only command, so commands/ becomes its canonical implementation while the old ci/ path remains a forwarding deprecation wrapper until P11.5. The manifest verifier is an internal package engine used by Validate and base-owned fixtures, so it moves to engine/ and receives no permanent compatibility wrapper. A base-owned test bridge first resolves exactly one legacy or engine-owned manifest verifier, preserving fail-closed candidate validation across the move. This applies Plan 06 sections 6, 13 and P10.3/P10.6 together with D15 and D23.
